name: Winter Frontier Fishery
summary: Kurll at Valormok asks you for winter squid from the Azshara coast. He values a varied diet and would appreciate the fish.

sections.title: A Varied Diet
sections.body: Kurll at Valormok prefers the safety of land to angling. Winter squid are in season along Azshara's coast, and he asks you to bring him some for a more varied diet.

faq.answer: Kurll at Valormok asks you for winter squid.

faq.q: Where can I fish for winter squid?
faq.answer: Winter squid can be fished from the coast of Azshara.

faq.q: Why does Kurll want winter squid?
faq.answer: Kurll says a varied diet makes the body stronger.
Kurll says he prefers the safety of land to angling.

attribution: In-game quest text: Winter Frontier Fishery
